payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes row-wise minima and column-wise maxima, then scans all cells to find one that equals both; if found prints it else 'GUESS'. Simple exhaustive check.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a complete search over all matrix cells. No backtracking or recursion, but among the limited candidate subtypes, search_backtracking is the broadest match for exhaustive search.
